articles.summary: Bodega Boyz started with a group of Queens friends comparing cannabis flower in 2021. Today the brand sells Deuces dual-chamber vapes, Loosies pre-rolls, and flower across six markets.
articles.title: Bodega Boyz: How Corner-Store Culture and a Crew of Queens Friends Built a Multi-State Cannabis Brand

articles.summary: Moon Made Farms is a female-owned regenerative sungrown cannabis farm located in Humboldt County’s Emerald Triangle. Founded by Tina Gordon, the Garberville-based farm cultivates small-batch organic cannabis using living soil, regenerative farming practices, and lunar cultivation principles. From award-winning genetics to its signature Queen Cola releases, Moon Made Farms represents the evolving future of California-sungrown cannabis.
articles.title: Inside Moon Made Farms: Regenerative Sungrown Cannabis from Humboldt’s Emerald Triangle

articles.summary: Founded in 2006 by brothers Steve and Michael Ashbel, MMD grew from a North Hollywood medical collective serving cancer and AIDS patients into six dispensaries across California and New Jersey, and is marking 20 years with the ALS Network.
articles.title: Medical Marijuana Dispensary, a North Hollywood Medical Collective, Turns 20

articles.summary: Time Machine is a California cannabis brand founded in 2022 by the team behind Pacific Stone, greenhouse-grown in Carpinteria with a lineup built around smooth smoke, bold flavor, and a playful concept rooted in cannabis's long history. Their 28pk Fuel-Rod Pre-Roll was a first-to-market format that others followed. Their flower pouches keep climbing. This summer, their infused smalls line returns in a new format: a 14g THCa-infused pouch.
articles.title: Time Machine is a Playful Greenhouse Cannabis Brand for Adventurous Spirits

articles.summary: In a California cannabis market defined by premium positioning and lifestyle branding, Pacific Stone took a different path. The family-owned greenhouse brand — founded in 2015 and based in Carpinteria, California — built its reputation on quality, consistency, and accessible pricing. Today, Pacific Stone is one of the most consistently recommended affordable cannabis brands in California, with a catalog spanning pre-roll tins, hemp-wrapped blunts, and large-format flower that has made it a first recommendation at dispensaries across the state.
articles.title: Inside Pacific Stone: Decade of California Cannabis from a Family-Owned Carpinteria Greenhouse

articles.summary: "We are not interested in making generic cannabis," says the Maven Genetics team. Inside the L.A. brand's product-first approach to flower, pre-rolls, and vapes. Maven Genetics built a Los Angeles cannabis brand on proprietary genetics and connoisseur standards, and it's expanding into New York, Illinois, and Nevada.
articles.title: Inside Maven Genetics: The Los Angeles Brand Bringing Connoisseur Standards to California Cannabis
